evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix(McpClientTool Node): Filter out tool arguments unless explicitly allowed
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix(McpClientTool Node): Filter out tool arguments unless explicitly allowed

## Summary

Refines the check introduced in https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/23167 that filters out mcp tool arguments. The logic is now to filter out all unknown tool arguments unless they are explicitly allowed in the schema via `additionalProperties: true`. This addresses the issue that some MCP server implementation does not specify `additionalProperties: false` in the tool input schema but still throw validation errors when additional data is present (see #21716). I did reproduce this input schema behavior for [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/getting-started/welcome) (missing `additionalProperties` in the schema but validation error when additional arguments are passed).
